news.description: The Patriots placed veteran wide receiver Mack Hollins on injured reserve Saturday with a calf injury.

news.headline: Christian McCaffrey, Olivia Culpo announce birth of second child
news.description: McCaffrey and his wife, Olivia Culpo, announced the news of the birth of their second child in a joint post on Instagram on Saturday.

news.headline: Rams: Myles Garrett making 'good progress,' but no return timeline
news.description: Los Angeles Rams defensive end Myles Garrett is "making good progress" in his recovery from knee surgery, coach Sean McVay said, but the team is unlikely to open his 21-day practice window next week.

news.headline: Steelers place WR Michael Pittman Jr. on IR with foot injury
news.description: The Pittsburgh Steelers placed wide receiver Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) on injured reserve, the team announced on Saturday.

news.headline: Bills rule out Ed Oliver, Joshua Palmer, wait on WR DJ Moore
news.description: Bills wide receiver DJ Moore returned to practice in a noncontact jersey and will be designated as questionable for "Monday Night Football" against the Rams. Buffalo has ruled out wide receiver Joshua Palmer and defensive tackle Ed Oliver.

news.headline: Can the Seahawks' defense again silence the 49ers' hot offense Sunday?
news.description: Seattle's defense stole the show the past two times these teams met. But the 49ers and Brock Purdy are on a roll heading into Week 5.

news.headline: Saquon Barkley, DeVonta Smith among 5 Eagles ruled out vs. Jags
news.description: Eagles running back Saquon Barkley, wide receiver DeVonta Smith, new starting center Drew Kendall, safety Marcus Epps and wide receiver Hollywood Brown were all ruled out for Sunday's game in London against the Jaguars.

news.headline: Can Burrow, Bengals establish identity vs. Dolphins?

news.headline: How wild-card game sent Bears, Packers in opposite directions
news.description: Ever since Chicago sent Green Bay home, the Bears have taken flight and the Packers can't find their footing.

news.headline: Rams DT Aaron Donald practices in full, plans to play MNF
news.description: Rams defensive tackle Aaron Donald practiced in full Friday and said he plans to play Monday night against the Bills after missing Week 4 with back soreness.

news.headline: Fantasy football buzz: Expect Bears' Swift to retain RB1 role with Monangai out
news.description: D'Andre Swift will be the Bears' RB1 with Kyle Monangai out, with Roschon Johnson potentially getting work.
